string.text: Co-op: manual saving is off. The game saves itself; to go back to an autosave use Restore in the Co-op window.
Co-op: manual saving is off. The host's game saves itself automatically.
Co-op: loading is off during a session. To go back to an autosave use Restore in the Co-op window.
Co-op: loading is off during a session. Leave the session first (coop_disconnect).
Restore an autosave
Restore an autosave
Autosaves (coop_auto_N) found in the saves folder, newest first. They may come from earlier sessions or other campaigns, so check the level and the time. Pick the moment the whole group goes back to.
No autosaves yet. The game saves itself on a new level, after a shared sleep, on a timer and when the session ends.
Restore %s (%s, game time %s, saved %s)? The whole group goes back to that moment: everything done since is lost and every player reloads the world. Press Restore to confirm.
Restore
